00835:     private fun createDownloadOutputStream(context: Context, fileName: String): OutputStream {
00836:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
00837:             try {
00838:                 val resolver = context.contentResolver
00839:                 val contentValues = ContentValues().apply {
00840:                     put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, fileName)
00841:                     put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, getMimeType(fileName))
00842:                     put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00843:                 }
00844:                 val uri = resolver.insert(MediaStore.Downloads.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, contentValues)
00845:                 if (uri != null) {
00846:                     val os = resolver.openOutputStream(uri)
00847:                     if (os != null) return os
00848:                 }
00849:             } catch (e: Exception) {
00850:                 Log.e("MeshFilesDownload", "ContentResolver download insert failed, falling back: ${e.localizedMessage}")
00851:             }
00852:         }
00853:
00854:         val downloadsDir = context.getExternalFilesDir(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00855:             ?: Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS)
00856:         if (!downloadsDir.exists()) {
00857:             downloadsDir.mkdirs()
00858:         }
00859:         val destFile = File(downloadsDir, fileName)
00860:         return FileOutputStream(destFile)
00861:     }
00862:
00863:     private fun getMimeType(fileName: String): String {
00864:         val extension = fileName.substringAfterLast('.', "").lowercase()
00865:         return when (extension) {
00866:             "pdf" -> "application/pdf"
00867:             "png" -> "image/png"
00868:             "jpg", "jpeg" -> "image/jpeg"
00869:             "gif" -> "image/gif"
00870:             "txt", "log", "conf", "cfg" -> "text/plain"
00871:             "html", "htm" -> "text/html"
00872:             "json" -> "application/json"
00873:             "zip" -> "application/zip"
00874:             "apk" -> "application/vnd.android.package-archive"
00875:             "mp3" -> "audio/mpeg"
00876:             "mp4" -> "video/mp4"
00877:             else -> "application/octet-stream"
00878:         }
00879:     }

00881:     fun downloadFileToDownloads(
00882:         context: Context,
00883:         item: FileItem,
00884:         customName: String? = null,
00885:         overwrite: Boolean = false
00886:     ) {
00887:         val targetName = customName?.trim()?.ifBlank { null } ?: item.name
00888:
00889:         if (overwrite) {
00890:             deleteLocalDownloadFileIfExists(context, targetName)
00891:         }
00892:
00893:         val meshId = meshClient.getNodeMeshId(nodeId)
00894:         val serverUrl = meshClient.serverUrl.trimEnd('/')
00895:
00896:         val cookieToken = meshClient.userAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
00897:             meshClient.relayAuthCookie.ifEmpty {
00898:                 meshClient.extractRawToken(meshClient.authCookie)
00899:             }
00900:         }
00901:         val sessionCookie = meshClient.authCookie.trim()
00902:
00903:         Toast.makeText(context, context.getString(R.string.starting_download, targetName), Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
00904:
00905:         val progress = TransferProgress(
00906:             fileName = targetName,
00907:             filePath = item.path,
00908:             isUpload = false,
00909:             bytesTransferred = 0L,
00910:             totalBytes = item.size
00911:         )
00912:
00913:         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value
00914:             .filter { it.filePath != item.path } + progress
00915:
00916:         updateDownloadNotification(context, targetName, item.path, 0L, item.size)
00917:
00918:         val reqIdStr = Random.nextInt(100000, 999999).toString()
00919:
00920:         val session = ActiveDownloadSession(
00921:             filePath = item.path,
00922:             fileName = targetName,
00923:             reqId = reqIdStr,
00924:             totalSize = item.size,
00925:             receivedBytes = 0L,
00926:             outputStream = null,
00927:             downloadJob = null,
00928:             context = context
00929:         )
00930:         activeDownloads[item.path] = session
00931:
00932:         session.downloadJob = scope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
00933:             var downloadSuccess = false
00934:
00935:             while (!downloadSuccess && activeDownloads.containsKey(item.path) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
00936:                 try {
00937:                     if (!ensureConnected()) {
00938:                         delay(2000)
00939:                         continue
00940:                     }
00941:
00942:                     session.receivedBytes = 0L
00943:                     _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
00944:                         if (it.filePath == item.path) it.copy(bytesTransferred = 0L, totalBytes = item.size) else it
00945:                     }
00946:
00947:                     deleteLocalDownloadFileIfExists(context, targetName)
00948:
00949:                     // 1. Attempt HTTP Download
00950:                     try {
00951:                         val outputStream = createDownloadOutputStream(context, targetName)
00952:                         session.outputStream = outputStream
00953:                         val client = OkHttpHelper.createDownloadClient(meshClient.ignoreSsl)
00954:
00955:                         val encodedC = try { URLEncoder.encode(cookieToken, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cookieToken }
00956:                         val encodedM = try { URLEncoder.encode(meshId, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { meshId }
00957:                         val encodedN = try { URLEncoder.encode(cleanNodeId, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cleanNodeId }
00958:
00959:                         val cleanPath = item.path.removePrefix("/")
00960:                         val encodedF1 = try { URLEncoder.encode(cleanPath, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { cleanPath }
00961:                         val encodedF2 = try { URLEncoder.encode(item.path, "UTF-8") } catch (_: Exception) { item.path }
00962:
00963:                         var downloadUrl = "$serverUrl/devicefile.ashx?c=$encodedC&m=$encodedM&n=$encodedN&f=$encodedF1"
00964:                         var reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(downloadUrl).get()
00965:                         if (sessionCookie.isNotBlank()) reqBuilder.addHeader("Cookie", sessionCookie)
00966:
00967:                         var response = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build()).execute()
00968:
00969:                         if (!response.isSuccessful) {
00970:                             downloadUrl = "$serverUrl/devicefile.ashx?c=$encodedC&m=$encodedM&n=$encodedN&f=$encodedF2"
00971:                             reqBuilder = Request.Builder().url(downloadUrl).get()
00972:                             if (sessionCookie.isNotBlank()) reqBuilder.addHeader("Cookie", sessionCookie)
00973:                             response = client.newCall(reqBuilder.build()).execute()
00974:                         }
00975:
00976:                         if (response.isSuccessful && response.body != null) {
00977:                             val body = response.body!!
00978:                             val inputStream = body.byteStream()
00979:                             val contentLength = body.contentLength()
00980:                             val totalSize = if (contentLength > 0) contentLength else item.size
00981:
00982:                             var receivedBytes = 0L
00983:                             val buffer = ByteArray(64 * 1024)
00984:
00985:                             inputStream.use { input ->
00986:                                 outputStream.use { output ->
00987:                                     while (activeDownloads.containsKey(item.path) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
00988:                                         val bytesRead = input.read(buffer)
00989:                                         if (bytesRead == -1) break
00990:
00991:                                         output.write(buffer, 0, bytesRead)
00992:                                         receivedBytes += bytesRead
00993:                                         session.receivedBytes = receivedBytes
00994:
00995:                                         val current = receivedBytes
00996:                                         _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
00997:                                             if (it.filePath == item.path) {
00998:                                                 it.copy(
00999:                                                     bytesTransferred = current,
01000:                                                     totalBytes = if (totalSize > 0) totalSize else current
01001:                                                 )
01002:                                             } else {
01003:                                                 it
01004:                                             }
01005:                                         }
01006:                                         updateDownloadNotification(context, targetName, item.path, receivedBytes, totalSize)
01007:                                     }
01008:                                     output.flush()
01009:                                 }
01010:                             }
01011:
01012:                             if (activeDownloads.containsKey(item.path) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01013:                                 if (totalSize <= 0 || receivedBytes >= totalSize) {
01014:                                     downloadSuccess = true
01015:                                     _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.map {
01016:                                         if (it.filePath == item.path) {
01017:                                             it.copy(
01018:                                                 bytesTransferred = receivedBytes,
01019:                                                 totalBytes = if (totalSize > 0) totalSize else receivedBytes,
01020:                                                 isCompleted = true
01021:                                             )
01022:                                         } else {
01023:                                             it
01024:                                         }
01025:                                     }
01026:
01027:                                     showDownloadCompleteNotification(context, targetName, item.path, receivedBytes)
01028:                                     withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
01029:                                         Toast.makeText(
01030:                                             context,
01031:                                             context.getString(R.string.download_complete, targetName, formatSize(receivedBytes)),
01032:                                             Toast.LENGTH_LONG
01033:                                         ).show()
01034:                                     }
01035:
01036:                                     delay(1200)
01037:                                     activeDownloads.remove(item.path)
01038:                                     _activeTransfers.value = _activeTransfers.value.filter { it.filePath != item.path }
01039:                                     return@launch
01040:                                 } else {
01041:                                     throw java.io.IOException("Incomplete HTTP download ($receivedBytes / $totalSize bytes)")
01042:                                 }
01043:                             }
01044:                         } else {
01045:                             Log.w("MeshFilesDownload", "HTTP download endpoint returned status ${response.code}")
01046:                         }
01047:                     } catch (e: Exception) {
01048:                         if (e is CancellationException) throw e
01049:                         Log.w("MeshFilesDownload", "HTTP download attempt failed: ${e.localizedMessage}")
01050:                     } finally {
01051:                         try {
01052:                             session.outputStream?.close()
01053:                         } catch (_: Exception) {}
01054:                         session.outputStream = null
01055:                     }
01056:
01057:                     // 2. Attempt WebSocket readfile download if HTTP did not complete
01058:                     if (!downloadSuccess && activeDownloads.containsKey(item.path) && coroutineContext.isActive) {
01059:                         Log.d("MeshFilesDownload", "Attempting WS fallback download for ${item.path}...")
01060:
01061:                         if (!ensureConnected()) {
01062:                             throw java.io.IOException("WebSocket not connected for fallback download")
01063:                         }
01064:
01065:                         val outputStream = createDownloadOutputStream(context, targetName)
01066:                         session.outputStream = outputStream
01067:                         session.receivedBytes = 0L
01068:
01069:                         val readReq = JsonObject().apply {
01070:                             addProperty("action", "readfile")
01071:                             addProperty("path", item.path)
01072:                             addProperty("reqid", reqIdStr)
01073:                             addProperty("id", reqIdStr)
01074:                         }
01075:
01076:                         val ws = webSocket
01077:                         if (ws == null || !ws.send(readReq.toString())) {
01078:                             throw java.io.IOException("Failed to send readfile WebSocket command")
01079:                         }
